body: Hey {player_name}! We met at the harbour conference, right? Loved your talk on forecasting dashboards.[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: You do not recall meeting this person, and the chat is unprompted
Quickly asks for your direct contact details
tells.text: I am putting together a small analyst group, mind sharing your direct number?

tells.flag: Moves you to an unapproved app
tells.text: Add me on this other messenger instead.

explanation: Flattery and false shared history create instant friendliness. People rarely challenge someone who seems to know them.

subject: Quick favour
body: Hi {player_name}, hope the weekend was good! I am on my phone while travelling and my usual email is playing up, so I am writing from here. Are you free for a quick favour later?[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: Your manager's usual address is on 'northstar.example', not 'northstar-mail.example'
Asks you to keep using the new address
tells.text: Please reply to this address only for now.

tells.flag: Prevents you from phoning to check
tells.text: Do not call me, my phone is broken.

explanation: A familiar name plus a plausible excuse for the odd address. The excuse itself is the red flag.

body: Hi it's Imani from HR, new phone! Could you send me the spreadsheet with everyone's home addresses? Doing the holiday cards, thanks![[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: Unsaved number; HR would use the HR system and would not ask for a full address list by text
Steers you away from company email
tells.text: Just text it here, email is slow.

explanation: A friendly tone and a harmless reason hide a request for bulk personal data.

body: Still need that favour, {player_name}. It is the vendor payment we talked about. Change the bank details to the new account and do not loop in Finance.[[t3]][[t5]]

tells.flag: Skipping Finance's change-of-bank-details check is a major red flag

tells.text: You have always been the one I trust with this.
I am boarding, cannot talk. Just do it.

explanation: Bank-detail-change fraud. After weeks of friendly contact, the request feels like a favour. The process (Finance verification) is what protects you.
